faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PSC Bank Gold Jewels Appraiser recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PSC Bank Gold Jewels Appraiser recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the Gold Jewels Appraiser post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Gold Jewels Appraiser post is 25 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years as of the application deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed H.Sc. (+2) and possess a Diploma in Gold Jewels Appraiser from a recognized institution. A CIBIL score above 700 and Puducherry residency are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Gold Jewels Appraiser position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST, Women) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Gold Jewels Appraiser role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Gold Jewels Appraiser post will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to qualify in both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Gold Jewels Appraiser post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Gold Jewels Appraiser position is offered on a commission basis. Specific details regarding the commission structure are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Does the PSC Bank offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such details.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, which typically include a photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates. Refer to the notification for a complete list.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of Puducherry State Cooperative Bank (PSC Bank) at psc.bank.in.
